assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias
The monitoring may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk
The required precertification referenced in the CO-197 denial was not obtained prior to the service date
The clinical indication supports coverage of this diagnostic procedure
